dogecoin.text: @wancz1997 Unlike Cosmos and Polkadot, we are chain agnostic and can even support chains like Bitcoin and Dogecoin

3/ Important legacy chains like #Bitcoin, #Dogecoin, #Monero, and others don’t have a level of general smart contract capability to support sophisticated dApps (AMM exchanges, collateralized borrowing/lending markets with pools, etc.).

The approach is future-proof for developers because their apps inherent native connectivity with future chains the ZetaChain ecosystem adds e.g. Dogecoin, Solana, Base, 70+ Cosmos IBC chains, and so on. ZetaChain is chain-agnostic in its ability to support any chain.
